# Dataset inventory — clips and hours, real and fake

**Owner L, Week 12.** Generated by `python -m src.reporting.datasets`. Counts come
from the manifests; hours are **measured** from audio headers or from
`clip_index.csv`, never estimated. `docs/datasheet.md` remains the written record;
this is the arithmetic, regenerable on demand.

## 1. Bonafide source corpora (code-mixed)

| Corpus | Clips | Hours | Speakers |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| HiACC (adult subset only) | 3,318 | 3.2 | 24 |
| MUCS 2021 Hindi–English | 52,825 | 89.5 | 520 |
| **Total** | **56,143** | **92.8** | **544** |

Child audio from HiACC is quarantined and never used; see the datasheet, section 4.

## 2. ASVspoof 2019 LA (English, Stage-1 training and the English column)

| Split | Real clips | Real hours | Fake clips | Fake hours | Spoof : real |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| train | 2,580 | 2.4 | 22,800 | 21.7 | 8.8 : 1 |
| dev | 2,548 | 2.5 | 22,296 | 21.5 | 8.8 : 1 |
| eval | 7,355 | 6.9 | 63,882 | 54.6 | 8.7 : 1 |
| **Total** | | | | **109.7 h over 121,461 clips** | |

The fake side is ASVspoof's own attacks A01–A19. They are English and are not
related to the clones this project generated.

## 3. Attacks this project generated

| Attack | Tool | Clips on disk | Hours | Used in manifests | Hours used |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| CM01 + CM03 | XTTS-v2 | 4,025 | 7.0 | 7,497 | 13.4 |
| CM02 | RVC v2 | 1,500 | 2.6 | 2,435 | 4.3 |
| CM04 (held out) | Tortoise-TTS | 500 | 1.2 | 458 | 1.1 |

"On disk" is what the generator produced. "Used in manifests" counts every row of
every reported manifest, so a clip reused across the clean and channel copies of a
set is counted once per row. The two numbers answer different questions.

**CM05–CM09 do not exist.** kNN-VC, IndicTTS-Deepfake, IndicSynth and the AffectDF
subset are listed in the datasheet as planned and were never generated or indexed.

## 4. Per manifest, real against fake

| Manifest | Clips | Real | Real hours | Fake | Fake hours | Spoof : real |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `codemix_adapt_train` | 2,154 | 874 | 1.5 | 1,280 | 2.2 | 1.46 : 1 |
| `codemix_adapt_train_rvc` | 2,854 | 1,217 | 2.1 | 1,637 | 2.9 | 1.35 : 1 |
| `codemix_adapt_dev` | 506 | 186 | 0.4 | 320 | 0.6 | 1.72 : 1 |
| `codemix_eval` | 3,966 | 1,566 | 2.7 | 2,400 | 4.5 | 1.53 : 1 |
| `score_cm02` | 2,749 | 1,345 | 2.3 | 1,404 | 2.4 | 1.04 : 1 |
| `score_cm04_norm` | 2,024 | 1,566 | 2.7 | 458 | 1.1 | 0.29 : 1 |
| `rvc_holdout_train` | 700 | 343 | 0.6 | 357 | 0.7 | 1.04 : 1 |
| `rvc_holdout_test` | 619 | 302 | 0.5 | 317 | 0.5 | 1.05 : 1 |
| `gap_codemix_clean` † | 4,434 | 2,217 | 359.5 † | 2,217 | 3.8 | 1.0 : 1 |
| `asvspoof_train` | 25,380 | 2,580 | 2.4 | 22,800 | 21.7 | 8.84 : 1 |
| `asvspoof_dev` | 24,844 | 2,548 | 2.5 | 22,296 | 21.5 | 8.75 : 1 |
| `asvspoof_eval` | 71,237 | 7,355 | 6.9 | 63,882 | 54.6 | 8.69 : 1 |

† `gap_codemix_clean` is the odd one out: its bonafide rows point at **whole MUCS
source recordings** rather than segmented clips, and the same recording is
referenced many times. Summing per row gives 359.5 h; the **unique** audio behind
those 2,217 rows is 25 recordings totalling **3.8 h**. Every other manifest lists
one clip per row, so its hours are unique audio.

Each code-mixed evaluation manifest also exists in a channel-matched copy
(`*_channel20.csv`): the same clips through 8 kHz G.711 μ-law at 20 dB SNR. Those
copies hold no new audio and are not counted again here.
